minutes.headline: ZBA granted two special permits: a Prospect Street garage and a second floor on Embers restaurant within its footprint
minutes.summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals held two remote public hearings. It granted a special permit for an attached garage at 54 Prospect Street, with side setback and height relief. It then granted a special permit to add a second floor to the restaurant at 84 Lakefront, on condition that it stay within the existing footprint. The restaurant still needs planning board site plan review.

public_comment.topic: Next-door neighbor at 54 Prospect Street said the garage plan would work, would not be too close to her property line, and would not be an eyesore.
A Lakefront property owner spoke in strong support of the restaurant second-floor proposal and its effect on the lakefront area.

votes.motion: Accept the Prospect Street garage special permit proposal as is.
Grant the Lakefront second-floor special permit, conditioned that it stay within the footprint of the existing building.

decisions.decision: Chair announced the Prospect Street garage special permit granted after a roll call, with standard compliance contingencies.
Chair announced the Lakefront special permit granted, conditioned on staying within the existing footprint, with standard post-decision instructions.
A hearing is set for the seventh, with another about two weeks later. Staff said the end-of-February hearing involves four-unit condos on Mass Ave.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals granted a special permit to add a second floor to the restaurant at 84 Lakefront, on condition that it stay within the existing footprint.
The chair announced the Lakefront permit granted with the footprint condition and standard post-decision instructions.
The board accepted the Prospect Street attached-garage special permit proposal as is, and the chair announced it granted after a roll call.
The Prospect Street permit carries standard compliance contingencies and covers side setback and height relief.
Staff said a hearing at the end of February involves four-unit condos on Mass Ave.

why_it_matters: The Lakefront decision allows a larger restaurant building in the lakefront area, and the footprint condition limits how far the building can spread on the lot.
The Prospect Street grant shows how setback and height relief for a home addition is decided in a public hearing where abutters can speak.
watch_next: Planning board site plan review for the Embers restaurant, which the minutes say is still required.
